description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between evaluation context length and perplexity (PPL) for different values of gamma (γ). The x-axis is labeled “Evaluation Context Length” and has a linear scale ranging from 2K to 64K, with tick labels at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis is labeled “PPL” and has a linear scale ranging from 7.7 to 8.1, with tick labels at 7.7, 7.8, 7.9, and 8.0, and 8.1. 

The first line, colored blue and marked with circular data points, represents γ = 0.25. It begins at approximately 7.83 at 2K and declines to 7.78 at 64K, with a local minimum of 7.77 at 32K. The second line, colored orange and marked with circular data points, represents γ = 0.5. It starts at approximately 7.78 at 2K and declines to 7.74 at 64K, with a local minimum of 7.73 at 16K. The third line, colored green and marked with circular data points, represents γ = 0.75. It begins at approximately 8.13 at 2K and declines to 7.75 at 64K, with a local minimum of 7.74 at 32K.
